title: Research Software Engineer
description:
Research Software Engineer at Cumulus Research

This is a fictional posting for the Jobweaver demo. Maintain reproducible climate data tools for a small research team.

Tasks
Convert incoming files into documented datasets. Investigate quality issues and explain the results to colleagues. Maintain Python scripts and review small changes with the team.

Requirements
Python for scientific data processing. Experience cleaning and checking datasets. Version control with Git. English is the working language. German is not required.

Salary
EUR 62,000 gross per year. Hybrid working by agreement. Applications shown in this demo are fictional.
summary: Maintain reproducible climate data tools for a small research team.

match_analysis.synthesis: Alex’s climate-data scripts and released Python package connect directly to the role. This score is an illustrative demo value.

strengths.title: Python data preparation
strengths.detail: The career record describes scripts converting 40 TB of model output into NetCDF files.

strengths.title: Quality checks
strengths.detail: Alex adapted a tool to flag corrupted model runs before analysis.

gaps.title: Experience to clarify
gaps.detail: The record does not describe production services or on-call duties.
